incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: CSBU WorkMate opened, but the local CSBU WorkMate backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart CSBU WorkMate.

incompleteInstallation.title: CSBU WorkMate installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so CSBU WorkMate backend cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest CSBU WorkMate. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined CSBU WorkMate backend.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest CSBU WorkMate package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined CSBU WorkMate components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: CSBU WorkMate package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This CSBU WorkMate package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: CSBU WorkMate opened, but CSBU WorkMate backend stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling CSBU WorkMate may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: CSBU WorkMate opened, but CSBU WorkMate backend stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling CSBU WorkMate may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: CSBU WorkMate opened, but CSBU WorkMate backend could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart CSBU WorkMate.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: CSBU WorkMate detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, CSBU WorkMate will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: CSBU WorkMate is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another CSBU WorkMate startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart CSBU WorkMate.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: CSBU WorkMate backend is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: CSBU WorkMate backend couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

crashRecovery.title: A previous crash was detected
crashRecovery.description: The app previously exited because of a native process crash. You can restart once in safe mode or continue normally. Safe mode only disables hardware acceleration and the desktop pet.
crashRecovery.openReportsFailed: Could not open the crash reports folder
crashRecovery.actionFailed: The recovery action failed. Please try again.
crashRecovery.restartFailed: Automatic restart is unavailable in development mode. Start manually with --safe-mode.
